author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
If you’ve ever wanted to experience China beyond the guidebooks, come travel with us:
littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

We’re in the world's largest mushroom area near Chuxiong in Yunnan, China. We have never gathered so many mushrooms in our lives in such a short time. After collecting mushrooms we went to a special restaurant that cooked them for us 🇨🇳
